expectation: Membrane/junctional ring stain in epithelial cells (tumour glands, epithelium), common in epithelial regions, absent from stroma and lymphoid cells; reduced on poorly cohesive tumour cells. Expect glandular, sheet-like or tubular epithelial structures against dim stroma.
observed: A: yellow signal fills epithelial-looking glandular and sheet-like tissue islands and is absent from adjacent stroma. Several cores are nearly negative, consistent with stroma. B, C: honeycomb membrane rings around blue nuclei in gland epithelium, with the lumen and stroma dark. D: clear polygonal lattice of cell borders.
why: Specific junctional membrane staining of epithelial glands and sheets, absent from stroma, matches the expected Ecad pattern at every scale.
